purpose: route capture diagnosis and c1 decode route-fixture collection; not a promoted speed result

compiled_route_counter_run.finding: Python route hooks are registered and called during prefill, but one-token decode in the accepted compiled replay bypasses Python route capture.

eager_route_fixture_run.finding: Eager route fixtures captured decode routes. For c1 decode, each layer is fundamentally a single-token topk-8 sparse expert call; hot batching is not the primary c1 shape.

decisions: Do not compare eager route-fixture speed to the accepted graph path.
For route attribution under accepted graph replay, route capture must be graph-output or custom-op based, not Python callback based.
For c1 speed, prioritize a persistent single-token/topk-8 W8A8 MoE path over hot-batch grouped GEMM alone.
Keep hot-expert replication as a secondary memory-for-latency idea for aggregate or multi-token speculative branches, not as the lead c1 fix.
